```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(dplyr)


# We have multiple partial tree files from METABOLIC that need to be comined first
files <- c(
  "gtdbtk.bac120.classify.tree.1.tree",
  "gtdbtk.bac120.classify.tree.2.tree",
  "gtdbtk.bac120.classify.tree.3.tree",
  "gtdbtk.bac120.classify.tree.5.tree",
  "gtdbtk.bac120.classify.tree.8.tree"
)

# Read them all
trees <- lapply(files, read.tree)

# Combine them
combined_tree <- Reduce(function(x, y) bind.tree(x, y, where = "root"), trees)

# Save
write.tree(combined_tree, "combined_gtdbtk_tree.tree")

```



circular layout and add color for phylum - gonna re run the entire thing because this can be streamlined but keeping earlier bits of code in case I need it for something else later
This tree has a label for every MAG (215)


```{r}
#---------------------------------------------
# Load libraries
#---------------------------------------------
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(tidytree)
library(svglite)


#---------------------------------------------
# Load data
#---------------------------------------------
tree <- read.tree("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/combined_gtdbtk_tree.tree")

summary_file <- read.table("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
                           sep="\t", header=TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------
# Identify MAGs and references to keep
#---------------------------------------------
mags <- summary_file$user_genome
tips_to_keep <- unique(c(mags))

tree_pruned <- keep.tip(tree, tips_to_keep)

#save in case you want to use this tree file on a different platform like iTOL
write.tree(tree_pruned, "pruned_tree.tree")

#---------------------------------------------
# Extract Genus and Phylum
#---------------------------------------------
summary_file <- summary_file %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = str_extract(classification, "g__[^;]+") %>% str_replace("g__", ""),
    Phylum = str_extract(classification, "p__[^;]+") %>% str_replace("p__", "")
  )

# Map MAG tip labels to Genus
label_map <- summary_file %>%
  dplyr::select(user_genome, Genus, Phylum)

tree_pruned$tip.label <- ifelse(tree_pruned$tip.label %in% label_map$user_genome,
                                label_map$Genus[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, label_map$user_genome)],
                                tree_pruned$tip.label)

#---------------------------------------------
# Create a dataframe for coloring points by phylum
#---------------------------------------------
tip_colors <- data.frame(
  label = tree_pruned$tip.label,
  Phylum = label_map$Phylum[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, label_map$Genus)]
)

#---------------------------------------------
# Plot circular tree
#---------------------------------------------

# Base tree
p <- ggtree(tree_pruned, layout = "circular") %<+% tip_colors +
  geom_tiplab(size=2, color="black", align=TRUE) + # tip labels stay black
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Phylum), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Actinomycetota" = "#E78AC3",
    "Bacteroidota"   = "#FD8D63",
    "Cyanobacteriota"= "#8DA0CB",
    "Pseudomonadota" = "#66C2A6"
  )) +
  ggtitle("Phylogenetic Tree of MAGs and References") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p

#save it in this format to be able to edit in inkscape
ggsave("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/phylo_tree.svg",
       p, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)


```

This is the same thing but only labeling our best MAGs (40)
```{r}
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

#---------------------------------------------
# Load data
#---------------------------------------------
tree <- read.tree("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/combined_gtdbtk_tree.tree")
summary_file <- read.table("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
                           sep="\t", header=TRUE)
best_mags_summary <- read.table("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output_bestMAGsonly/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
                                sep="\t", header=TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------
# Identify MAGs and references to keep
#---------------------------------------------
mags <- summary_file$user_genome
tips_to_keep <- unique(c(mags))
tree_pruned <- keep.tip(tree, tips_to_keep)

#---------------------------------------------
# Extract Genus and Phylum
#---------------------------------------------
summary_file <- summary_file %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = str_extract(classification, "g__[^;]+") %>% str_replace("g__", ""),
    Phylum = str_extract(classification, "p__[^;]+") %>% str_replace("p__", "")
  )

best_mags_summary <- best_mags_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = str_extract(classification, "g__[^;]+") %>% str_replace("g__", ""),
    Phylum = str_extract(classification, "p__[^;]+") %>% str_replace("p__", "")
  )

#---------------------------------------------
# Map Genus labels for best MAGs only
#---------------------------------------------
tip_labels <- data.frame(
  tip = tree_pruned$tip.label,
  Genus_label = ifelse(tree_pruned$tip.label %in% best_mags_summary$user_genome,
                       best_mags_summary$Genus[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, best_mags_summary$user_genome)],
                       "")  # blank for everything else
)

#---------------------------------------------
# Map Phylum for coloring (MAGs from summary_file, references as "Reference")
#---------------------------------------------
tip_colors <- data.frame(
  tip = tree_pruned$tip.label,
  Phylum = "Reference",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

mag_idx <- tip_colors$tip %in% summary_file$user_genome
tip_colors$Phylum[mag_idx] <- summary_file$Phylum[match(tip_colors$tip[mag_idx], summary_file$user_genome)]

# Merge Genus labels into tip_colors
tip_colors <- tip_colors %>%
  mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(tip %in% best_mags_summary$user_genome,
                              best_mags_summary$Genus[match(tip, best_mags_summary$user_genome)],
                              ""))  # blank for everything else

#---------------------------------------------
# Plot circular tree
#---------------------------------------------
ggtree(tree_pruned, layout = "circular") %<+% tip_colors +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = Genus_label), size=3, align=TRUE) +  # only best MAGs labeled
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Phylum), size=2) +                 # color points by phylum
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Actinomycetota" = "#E78AC3",
    "Bacteroidota" = "#FD8D63",
    "Cyanobacteriota" = "#8DA0CB",
    "Pseudomonadota" = "#66C2A6"
  )) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  ggtitle("Phylogenetic Tree of MAGs and References")


# Save the plot
ggsave(
  filename = "F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/phylo_tree.png",
  plot = last_plot(),         # saves the last plot you made
  width = 12,                 # in inches
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300                   # high resolution
)



```



```{r}
# Select relevant columns
mag_phylo <- summary_file %>%
  dplyr::select(
    user_genome,
    closest_placement_reference,
    closest_placement_radius,
    closest_placement_taxonomy,
    closest_placement_ani,
    closest_placement_af
  )

# Quick overview: how far is each MAG from its placement reference
summary(mag_phylo$closest_placement_radius)

# Optional: visualize distance to reference
ggplot(mag_phylo, aes(x = closest_placement_radius)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "#66C2A6", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Phylogenetic Distance to Closest Reference (branch length)") +
  ylab("Number of MAGs") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of MAG distances to reference genomes")

# Optional: table of closest references for each MAG
mag_phylo %>%
  arrange(closest_placement_radius) %>%
  head(20)  # shows the 20 closest MAGs to their reference


```
